policy: People-related identities, rosters, attendees and staffing assignments are deferred by explicit Business direction. They are preserved as release blockers and are not requested in this run.

nonPeopleDecisions.decisionRequired: Choose Contacts source strategy: NEW SYSTEM ONLY or MIGRATION LATER if an approved source is subsequently supplied.
nonPeopleDecisions.recommendation: NEW SYSTEM ONLY for initial V1; never infer or fabricate Contacts.

nonPeopleDecisions.decisionRequired: Approve Customer cutover source strategy and final extract/freeze rule.
nonPeopleDecisions.recommendation: Approve current mapping/DQ basis and require a fresh final extract/hash at cutoff.

nonPeopleDecisions.decisionRequired: Approve Product/SKU source strategy, crosswalk and final extract/freeze rule.
nonPeopleDecisions.recommendation: Approve current seed/DQ basis and refresh/freeze the final binary at cutoff.

nonPeopleDecisions.decisionRequired: Select authoritative ERP, FX, Payments and Cheques systems/sources and initial extract/sync methods.
nonPeopleDecisions.recommendation: Trusted source integrations with stable source keys, raw lineage, correction history, DQ and reconciliation.

nonPeopleDecisions.decisionRequired: Approve cutover classifications for Complaints, Users, Roles, Country Scope, R&D access and Client bindings.
nonPeopleDecisions.recommendation: Complaints new-system-only; Users external provisioning; Roles/Country Scope/R&D configured at Go-Live; Client bindings external provisioning plus explicit audited configuration.

nonPeopleDecisions.decisionRequired: Approve or replace the exact Low/Expected/Peak production workload profile.
nonPeopleDecisions.recommendation: APPROVE AS INITIAL PRODUCTION BASELINE, followed by a formal production-like load/spike/soak run.

nonPeopleDecisions.decisionRequired: Approve or amend the 28-category retention matrix.
nonPeopleDecisions.recommendation: REQUIRES CHANGES: define exact Customer and Contact post-relationship periods, then obtain governance approval.

nonPeopleDecisions.decisionRequired: Choose a DR malware-scanning strategy for UAE Central or another approved DR region.
nonPeopleDecisions.recommendation: Evaluate failure-closed alternative scanning in UAE Central first; use another supported region if equivalence cannot be proven; do not default to a security exception.
nonPeopleDecisions.approverRole: Security + Technical/Azure; Business/Data if region/residency changes

peopleRelatedDeferred.topic: Training attendees, schedule and attendance evidence

externalExecutionDependencies.topic: Authorize and run production-like load/spike/soak after D-06 approval.
Run formal staging cutover and rollback rehearsals after decisions, staging and production evidence exist.
